convert_pdf_to_markdown: run docling to convert PDF files to markdown format with OCR and table extraction
convert_pdf_to_json: run docling to convert PDF files to JSON format with embedded images and layout data
convert_pdf_to_html: run docling to convert PDF files to HTML format with optional split-page view and layout visualization
convert_audio_to_transcript: run docling to transcribe audio files using Whisper models with configurable model size
convert_pdf_with_vlm: run docling to convert PDF files using a vision-language model preset for document understanding
show_docling_version: show docling version information including core, IBM models, parse, and platform details
show_external_plugins: list available third-party OCR, layout, and table plugin engines for docling
export_documents_with_profiling: export converted documents with profiling summary showing timing statistics per pipeline stage
